description: Machine-checkable capability-declaration format for provider adapters. Enforced by build-os/adapters/conformance.sh (bash + node, no external validator). Doctrine: build-os/adapters/ADAPTER_CONTRACT.md; memory: build-os/memory/provider_adapter_contract.md.

verification_rules.executed: verification.evidence must name executed proof in this repository (a suite that drives the adapter).
verification_rules.unverified: verification.access is REQUIRED with the four honesty facts below; nothing may be marked supported.

illegal_combinations.name: UNSUPPORTED-TIER-CLAIM
illegal_combinations.rule: A lifecycle point with supported=false MUST declare tier UNAVAILABLE. An unsupported operation measures nothing, so any measured tier on it is an overclaim.

illegal_combinations.name: EXACT-TELEMETRY-WITHOUT-OBSERVATION
illegal_combinations.rule: telemetry_report with tier EXACT MUST declare enforcement pre or post. EXACT means counted by the adapter itself, which requires an observation point; tokens-EXACT-with-enforcement-none is the canonical overclaim.

illegal_combinations.name: UNVERIFIED-SUPPORT
illegal_combinations.rule: verification.state != executed forbids supported=true on EVERY lifecycle point. Provider support is claimed only after a real successful call — four-state honesty (binary present / auth absent / host unreachable / no successful call) is recorded instead.

illegal_combinations.name: PHANTOM-ENFORCEMENT
illegal_combinations.rule: A lifecycle point with supported=false MUST declare enforcement none. Claiming an enforcement point for an operation the adapter does not implement invents a gate that does not exist.
